packageRules.description: Merge all GitHub Actions updates (versions, majors and digests) three days after release, once the checks of the pull request pass. Updates without a release date (digests) are not held. GitHub auto-merge waits for the required check of the main-requires-green-build ruleset.

Merge patch, digest and pin updates of Python requirements and of the Dockerfile (base image digest, syntax image) three days after release, once the checks pass. Digests have no release date and are not held (wolfi-base only offers latest). Minor and major updates stay manual.
